# `WheelMove`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Filter-wheel movement start, completion with position, or failure.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, WheelMove worker @0x3008c0, GetSlotsNum @0x302310 (64-bit build) |

Sent by the wheel movement worker and by slot-count initialisation (open_wheel), after the actual movement and position read. State family (NotifyState): caller-supplied state literal; error and code only when the supplied code is greater than 0. The complete event uses the value overload and carries position. No lapse_ms or route. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"WheelMove"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Caller-supplied literal. One of: `start`, `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `position` | integer | if state complete (value overload) | - | Filter-wheel position read after the move; physical mapping unresolved. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if supplied code > 0 | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if supplied code > 0 | - | Supplied error code. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, complete - Move finished (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"WheelMove","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","position":1}
```

Event, start - Move started (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"WheelMove","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start"}
```
